answer: Because the haven stake is held until the horizon settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the willow audit lists each exposure. A farm running 147 keys therefore pays that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation low-cost. An attester must stake 39% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer costs proportionally more than endorsing a inexpensive one. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
